en: Psalms 83
A song. A Psalm by Asaph.

p.src: 1  God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.

en: God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.
u.src: 1  God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.

p.src: 2  For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.

en: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.
u.src: 2  For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.

p.src: 3  They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.

en: They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.
u.src: 3  They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.

p.src: 4  “Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”

en: “Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”
u.src: 4  “Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”

p.src: 5  For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.

en: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.
u.src: 5  For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.

p.src: 6  The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;

en: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;
u.src: 6  The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;

p.src: 7  Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;

en: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;
u.src: 7  Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;

p.src: 8  Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot. Selah.

en: Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot. Selah.
u.src: 8  Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot. Selah.

p.src: 9  Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;

en: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;
u.src: 9  Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;

p.src: 10  who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.

en: who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.
u.src: 10  who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.

p.src: 11  Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,

en: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
u.src: 11  Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,

p.src: 12  who said, “Let’s take possession of God’s pasture lands.”

en: who said, “Let’s take possession of God’s pasture lands.”
u.src: 12  who said, “Let’s take possession of God’s pasture lands.”

p.src: 13  My God, make them like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind.

en: My God, make them like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind.
u.src: 13  My God, make them like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind.

p.src: 14  As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,

en: As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,
u.src: 14  As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,

p.src: 15  so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.

en: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.
u.src: 15  so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.

p.src: 16  Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, LORD.

en: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, LORD.
u.src: 16  Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, LORD.

p.src: 17  Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;

en: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;
u.src: 17  Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;

p.src: 18  that they may know that you alone, whose name is the LORD, are the Most High over all the earth.

en: that they may know that you alone, whose name is the LORD, are the Most High over all the earth.
u.src: 18  that they may know that you alone, whose name is the LORD, are the Most High over all the earth.

en: 83:18 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.
